decisions.reason: Placing images at the beginning of each chapter does not change the requirement to review their tone, colour-palette consistency, or chapter fit.
The image-placement decision does not affect the title page or its title-formatting constraint.
The same source message independently introduces one cover image, and that requirement is already fully represented by its existing same-message INTRODUCE Event.
Chapter-image placement does not alter the manuscript editing objective or any approved prose rewrites.
The layout decision does not change the requirement to provide paperback publishing guidance.
